description: Official OATS knowledge operations on Open Knowledge Format bases: the working-soul knowledge slot (consultation, instance knowledge and proposing knowledge by PR with `oats okf propose`), the knowledge maintainer capability and package soul that gates every merge, the proposal-review trigger template (harvest-review is its old name), and, until 7.0, the removed knowledge harvester's stub soul and capability, whose spawn always refuses with E_REMOVED naming the fix.
